purpose: Fixed development regression panel of previously reviewed residual outliers. Reuse these advertisement IDs across model iterations regardless of their new rank. Not a representative market sample, held-out test, or accuracy estimate.
origin: Eight largest absolute current-capture log residuals in the original case review; explicitly frozen here after user requested deliberate repeated-test selection.
missing_case_policy: Fail visibly if a member is absent. Do not replace it with the next residual outlier.
new_outliers: Review separately as a changing diagnostic queue; changing the fixed panel requires an explicit versioned revision.
